quick_skim.title: Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem Using Quantum Devices: QUBO and HOBO Formulations
quick_skim.abstract: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) forms the foundation for many logistics and optimization tasks. At the same time, this problem is NP-hard and requires significant computational resources. Quantum computing promises to substantially accelerate computations or increase solution accuracy. The TSP can be conveniently mapped onto the quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) formulation, which in turn can be solved using variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) and quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) methods, but this mapping requires a quadratic number of qubits. The higher-order binary optimization (HOBO) formulation requires significantly fewer qubits, but it contains higher-order terms. In our work, we thoroughly investigate both formulations and provide a practical recipe for solving the TSP. We give a comprehensive study and compare in detail QUBO and HOBO formulations.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Compares QUBO and HOBO formulations of the traveling salesman problem for VQE and QAOA on quantum devices, trading qubit count against higher-order terms.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对TSP在经典计算上求解代价高的问题，系统比较QUBO与HOBO两种二进制优化建模方式，并在量子设备上用VQE与QAOA求解。QUBO映射所需量子比特为二次方量级，HOBO比特更少但含高阶项。研究给出两种建模在比特规模与求解效果间的权衡，为量子求解TSP提供建模参考，但主要面向对称TSP而非ATSP。

quick_skim.llm_title_zh: 使用量子设备求解旅行商问题：QUBO与HOBO建模
quick_skim.llm_motivation_cn: TSP为NP难问题，经典求解资源开销大，量子方法有望加速或提高精度。
quick_skim.llm_method_cn: 将TSP分别写成QUBO与HOBO模型，并用VQE和QAOA在量子设备上求解。
quick_skim.llm_result_cn: 对比两种建模的量子比特需求与求解表现，HOBO显著减少比特但引入高阶项。
quick_skim.llm_conclusion_cn: 为量子求解TSP提供建模权衡参考，与ATSP求解有较强方法关联。
